ops.title: meme-drop: how a meme gets made

ops.label: Schedule: 12, 14, 16, 18, 20 IST
ops.detail: Cron 0 12-20/2 * * * in Asia/Kolkata on the Hetzner server. A Manual run trigger feeds the same first node for testing.

ops.label: Pull 2 random saved memes from Drive
ops.detail: Calibration exemplars for the writer at high detail, and style references if the meme ends up drawn by the image model.

ops.label: Load config, taste profile, last 40 log lines
ops.detail: meme-config.json and taste-profile.md from /files/inbox; meme-log.jsonl from /files/out. A missing file degrades the run instead of failing it.

ops.label: Fetch imgflip top-100 templates
ops.detail: id, name and box count for each. Skipped when imgflip credentials are empty, which forces every candidate to the image model.

ops.label: Seed: topic + hook + mechanism
ops.detail: Random draw from the config, excluding topics in the recent log and mechanisms used in the last five memes.

ops.label: Write 10 candidates
ops.detail: gpt-5.6-terra, reasoning effort medium, strict JSON schema. Each candidate: mechanism, render type, template and box texts or an image prompt, caption, one-line why.

ops.label: Score each 1-10, separate editor persona
ops.detail: gpt-5.6-luna, reasoning effort low. Sees the candidates without the writer's reasoning.

ops.label: Rewrite with the judge's verdicts
ops.detail: Top three captions, their scores and verdicts, plus the editor's one-line direction, go back to the writer as rejected shapes.

ops.label: Winner: highest score that validates
ops.detail: A template pick must name a real template id and match its box count. Ties go to the shorter caption. Nothing valid: the top scorer is drawn by the image model.

ops.label: imgflip caption_image
ops.detail: Form body url-encoded in a Code node and posted raw; box text goes into boxes[i][text]. Free tier adds a small watermark.

ops.label: Image model draws the scene
ops.detail: gpt-image-2.5-flare via images/edits with the 2 samples as style references. Caption rendered as separate lines in outlined meme lettering.

ops.label: Append line to meme-log.jsonl
ops.detail: Topic, hook, mechanism, render, template, caption, score, attempt, token usage. The last 40 lines are the workflow's memory.

ops.label: WhatsApp: Utility template meme_ready
ops.detail: Image uploaded as header, caption flattened to one line for the body parameter. Utility category, because Marketing templates are silently dropped for Indian numbers.

ops.label: Utility workflow meme-taste-profile, run by hand
Every saved meme in the Drive folder, at high detail
Rerun whenever memes are added to the folder
Deadpan stupidity, low-stakes hostility, reckless bravado
Short setups, loose grammar, image delivers the final word
Visual reframing: rotate reality instead of fixing it
Hypocrisy magnification: diet coke after the feast
Escalating comparison, then break the ladder
Bait-and-switch: imply one mistake, reveal a worse one
Literal category error: 'no im an air fryer'
Image as punchline: violent answer to mundane dialogue
Explaining the joke or softening the punchline
Ten rules
ops.detail: Start from a familiar annoyance; setup under twenty words; pivot once, violently; state the insane conclusion with confidence; let the image replace explanation; end immediately after the reveal.

ops.markdown:
**Persona:** the funniest shitposter alive, bored of nine thousand of the ten thousand memes it has written, writing for exactly one reader.

**Receives every run**
- Audience and spice level from the config
- The taste profile, verbatim
- Hard bans, style rules, the named mechanisms
- imgflip templates with box counts, plus format rules (Drake rejects then prefers, Expanding Brain has four tiers with the dumbest last)
- The last 40 memes sent, as "do not repeat"
- This run's seed: topic, hook, lead mechanism
- On a rewrite: the judge's verdicts on the rejected batch
- Two saved memes as images, at high detail

**Must return** 10 candidates in a strict JSON schema.

**Batch constraints**
- At least 60% on the seed topic, at least 3 use the hook
- At least 3 different mechanisms
- At most 30% drawn by the image model; the rest on real templates
- A drawn scene is the punchline itself, never a person looking confused

cells.c-means: Seen it, a brand could post it, or it explains itself
Competent, no laugh. Most candidates land here
Opens with 'when you' or 'me:'; banned topic; punchline not in the last box; a box over 60 characters; template mismatched to the joke; explaining it; wholesome
Specificity, a real swerve, brevity, total commitment, the image doing the work, dark enough to feel slightly bad for laughing
Picture the named template with its text before scoring; never favour a candidate because its image description reads more vividly
Best under 7: one rewrite with the verdicts. Second miss ships the best anyway, so a slot is never lost

cells.c-effect: Who the joke is for; the biggest lever on specificity
The pools one topic and one absurd angle are drawn from
Named joke structures the batch must spread across
Instant-fail words and openers; what removed WiFi and coffee
Share of candidates on real templates (0.7)
Batch size (10) and how many past memes are fed back (40)

cells.c-v2: Distilled profile plus 2 samples at high detail

cells.c-v1: Model's choice: WiFi, coffee, battery on repeat
cells.c-v2: His world, seeded, recent ones excluded
Real templates, or a drawn scene that is the joke

ops.markdown:
- **Meta says 'accepted' and delivers nothing.** Marketing templates are throttled for Indian numbers; the fix was a Utility template.
- **The judge preferred drawn memes.** It saw a vivid scene description for those and only a template name for the rest. The fairness rule evened the scores out.
- **n8n's JSON body field rejects bracket keys** like boxes[0][text]. The imgflip body is now url-encoded in code and posted raw.
- **Windows line endings in .env** made a trailing carriage return part of the password. Edit server files with nano; values are trimmed in the workflow as a backstop.
- **Convert To File empties the item's JSON**, so the caption is read from the node before it.
- **Google OAuth apps left in Testing** expire refresh tokens after seven days; the app had to be published.

ops.label: Reply-rating on WhatsApp feeds few-shot examples and the ban list
ops.detail: Phase 2: a Meta inbound webhook records a reply to each meme as a rating in the log. Top-rated captions become examples for the writer; bottom-rated shapes join the ban list.

ops.label: Delivery-status webhook, so a silent drop shows up as an error
ops.detail: Meta reports delivered or failed asynchronously; today the workflow only sees 'accepted'.

ops.question: Writer and judge are both OpenAI models. Does the judge share the writer's blind spots, and would a judge from a different provider score differently?
